name: pirate-reborn-guidebook
description: An offline-capable One Piece Pirate Reborn guidebook packaged for Android.

scripts.copy:web: npm run motion:build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/copy-web.ps1
scripts.android:add: npm run copy:web && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run copy:web && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/stage-app-profile-backup.ps1 && cap sync android
